name: To move out and away for the first time
author: MathJeKo
description:
I created a 3D environment to portray my experience of the change from living with my parents in Denmark to living by myself in Korea. I wanted to create a project from this experience, as this has been one of the most meaningful transformations for me, in terms of personal development. 
Hereby, the space will showcase my experience of moving out for the first time, primarily communicating my mentality and feelings connected to the change. However, this transition will be emphasised by the physical objects tied to my outer environments before and after moving. In this way, I have made use of objects and atmospheres from Copenhagen and Seoul, as well as colour, composition and navigational flow to represent my inner environment during this change.
